name: Biocon Ltd
title: Biocon Ltd - 532523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Biosimilars EBITDA up 33% to INR720 crores on 26% margin, but management guides no numbers, capex is largely done and Syngene's CRDMO grew only 2% with a single-client drag.

capex.quote: we don't see any need for a large greenfield capex

triggers.label: Major investment phase substantially complete
triggers.quote: this major investment phase is substantially complete

triggers.label: Interest cost down to INR210-220 crores
triggers.quote: about INR70 crores, INR75 crores per quarter of interest cost reduction is being reflected in the P&L

triggers.label: Biosimilars EBITDA +33% to INR720 crores
triggers.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹720 crores, representing growth of 33% on a year-on-year basis

guidance.value: Launch-led ramp expected mainly in H2 FY27, no numeric guidance
Hover between $1.1 billion and $1.2 billion, subject to working capital

red_flags.label: Syngene single-client biologics impact
red_flags.quote: Overall numbers reflected the specific impact from a single large molecule biologics client

red_flags.label: Generics EBITDA margin under 10%
red_flags.quote: you are seeing roughly under 10% EBITDA margin

evasions.topic: Q4 FY27 exit run-rate and FY27/28 biosimilar numbers
evasions.quote: while we've not guided specifically on any numbers
our terms for negotiation and settlement are confidential
there's no one number that we can give

evasions.topic: Biosimilar market share and insulin dollar sales
evasions.quote: in dollar terms, we've refrained from giving numbers
